body.name: Two-node chain counterfamilies
body.construction: For \(1\to2\), set \(B_{21}=b\neq0\), \(\omega=(u,v)\), and \(\tau=(t,s)\), so \(\Sigma_0=\begin{pmatrix}u&bu\\bu&b^2u+v\end{pmatrix}\), \(\Sigma_1=\begin{pmatrix}t&bt\\bt&b^2t+v\end{pmatrix}\), and \(\Sigma_2=\operatorname{diag}(u,s)\); use \((b,u,v,t,s)=(2,1,1,3,2)\) and \((1,1,1,1/2,2)\) as legal witnesses.
